answer: Proof of Stake mechanisms preserve network integrity by requiring agents to commit a crystal cache of native assets, functioning as a high-fidelity signal of commitment. By tying identity to the scarcity of capital rather than ephemeral compute, the protocol forces an attacker to acquire an onyx hoard of value to gain voting power. This economic barrier makes flooding the system with fake personas prohibitively expensive, as the cost to manufacture Sybil nodes scales linearly with the stake required.
